title: Convolutional neural networks in medical image understanding: a survey

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Convolutional neural networks in medical image understanding: a survey》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-7】This article aims to provide a comprehensive survey of applications of CNNs in medical image understanding.

【Abstract · abstract-1-8】The underlying objective is to motivate medical image understanding researchers to extensively apply CNNs in their research and diagnosis.
